quick_facts.sprint_goal: Invoices become legally submittable: PDF download for customers, Circular 78-compliant XML for the Vietnamese tax authority, and void+replacement workflow for corrected invoices.

content.tldr: Two invoice hardening tracks: (1) PDF generation backend + download frontend; (2) XML export compliant with Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC, plus void+replacement invoice workflow.
content.legal_reference: Thông tư 78/2021/TT-BTC — Quy định về hóa đơn điện tử. Invoice fields required: seller taxCode, buyer name/taxCode (optional), invoice number (immutable), issue date, line items with VAT rates, total VNĐ.

features_committed.title: Invoice PDF Generation + Download
features_committed.rationale: Customers expect a printable/downloadable invoice. Vietnamese law requires store to provide invoice on request.
tasks: T076: Install PDFKit (or pdfmake) in backend
T077: GET /invoices/:id/pdf — streams PDF response (Content-Type: application/pdf)
T078: PDF template: store name/address/taxCode, invoice number, issue date, line items table, VAT breakdown, totals in VNĐ — Vietnamese layout
T079: Frontend InvoiceDetailPage: 'Tải PDF' download button → window.open(/invoices/:id/pdf)
T080: PDF preview iframe in invoice detail (optional, if PDF fits viewport)

features_committed.title: Invoice XML Export (Circular 78 Compliant)
features_committed.rationale: Tax authority submission requires XML in specified schema under Circular 78.
tasks: T081: GET /invoices/:id/xml — returns application/xml with Circular 78 element structure
T082: GET /reports/invoices/export-xml?from=&to= — batch XML for monthly submission
T083: Schema validation in unit test (against reference XSD or sample documents)
T084: Frontend: 'Xuất XML' button on invoice detail + batch export on reports page

features_committed.title: Invoice Void + Replacement Workflow
features_committed.rationale: Under Vietnamese law, a voided invoice must be replaced by a new invoice with a new number and a reference to the original.
tasks: T085: Invoice entity: add replacedByInvoiceId FK (self-referential, nullable) + migration
T086: POST /invoices/:id/void-and-replace — creates replacement invoice, links originalInvoiceId
T087: Void+replace accessible to accountant + admin only
T088: Frontend: 'Huỷ & Thay thế' button on invoice detail (accountant role)

out_of_scope: Direct API submission to Vietnamese tax portal (operational dependency — post-MVP)
Buyer TaxCode capture on POS (Sprint 10 enhancement)
prerequisites: Sprint 8: Refund workflow complete (refunded invoices need void handling)

audit.author: vibe-project-manager
audit.note: Sprint 9 planned. Tax compliance: PDF + XML + void/replace. Full-stack delivery.
